entries: `/theme` restores your previous theme when you leave the picker any way other than `Enter`, such as `Esc`, `Ctrl+U`, `Tab` then `Esc`, or opening Settings or the dashboard

Selected and highlighted rows stay readable on every theme because reverse-video text is never dimmed. This fixes faint descriptions in selected menu rows on the `terminal` theme in terminals such as Kitty
`@` file completion shows results faster after you type
